title: Recorded CelebA-64 one-step drifting versus diffusion comparison
method: One-step direct-RGB GMD with frozen MAE-82 and ConvNeXt-13 features
scope: These measurements concern the one-step drifting generator; the composed Flow-GMD experiment is reported separately.
verification_scope: Values checked against the archived Markdown reports. Training and image evaluations were not rerun for this public documentation update.
training_replicates: One GMD training seed; no across-training-seed equivalence claim.

protocol.reference_and_evaluator: Within each split, the reports record matching reference, Inception and evaluator hashes, precision, generation and Inception batch sizes, quantization and metric protocol.
protocol.test_checkpoint_selection: Both checkpoints fixed before the recorded test comparison.
protocol.training_budget: GMD: 225000 updates; diffusion: 50000 updates. Training compute is not matched.
protocol.nfe_interpretation: Number of model evaluations; not a measured latency ratio.
